figures.caption: Table 1: Multi-seed comparison of five variants across four seeds. R = inter/intra cosine centroid ratio. CKA = Linear CKA between baseline and quantum features; lower indicates greater structural reorganization. πstar = learned star-topology weight at convergence. BackboneGrad: input projection trained via backbone pathway only (no gradient through quantum circuit; see Section 3). Geometry-loss: CE + feature geometry + angle geometry objectives (see Section 5.2); R column shows the geometry improvement.
Table 2: Ablation and variant results (seed 777 unless noted∗). Reference: Quantum-BackboneGrad 86.32%. R = inter/intra cosine centroid ratio. ∆ = Top-1 relative to reference.
Figure 2: Left: per-class representation effects are topology-dependent, not frequency-driven. Right: the star-topology preference is a consistent emergent property of backbone-coupled training.
